extensions.evidence_requirement_verbatim: A zero-finding result is only publishable with a detector control attached. On any real finding, quantify the blast radius (which commits, which index entries, which downstream consumers), recommend rotation explicitly, and hand it back to the owner - performing the rotation is the banned action, saying it is needed is not.
tests_required_verbatim: Detector control: a planted synthetic token in a scratch file must be found.
False-positive control: a bare zero-entropy prefix with no secret body must NOT fire.
Known-clean sentinel: a file with no secrets must score 0 hits.
Historical scope: the scan must cover committed history for the command-center tree, not only the working tree - deleting a leaked value is not sufficient.
named_probes: Probe 1: scan current program-corpus and command-center bytes with pinned gitleaks plus exact live-credential correlation, with detector, false-positive, and known-clean controls.

extensions.rotation_recommendation: Owner should rotate or revoke every exposed credential, invalidate aliases together, then migrate the bundle to a secret manager and purge every Git/archive/plain-copy entry.
